annotations.title: Plain-language guides to Vedic astrology (AstroCalc Learn)

description: Finds AstroCalc's plain-language guide chapters that answer a general question about Indian (Vedic) astrology, e.g. "what is Manglik dosha", "is 24 gunas enough", "what is Nadi dosha", "Saturn in the 7th house", "how do dashas work", "what is Sade Sati". Useful for general questions that need no birth data, when a source page the user can read is helpful; Hinglish works too, e.g. "Manglik dosh kya hota hai", "Nadi dosh kab cancel hota hai", "kitne gun milne chahiye". Returns up to 3 chapters with title, a short summary paragraph, the canonical URL, and links to the most relevant sections, in English or Hindi.

lang.description: Language of titles, summaries and URLs. Defaults to 'hi' for a question written in Devanagari, else 'en'.

question.description: The question or topic, in English, Hindi or Hinglish.
